notes: This focused benchmark verifies that the top-level tasks skill surfaces Tiber's durable final-review enforcement contract instead of relying on prose-only review guidance.
The disposable minimal workspace prevents task-board or repository mutation while the verifier checks the written policy artifact.

scenarios.title: Preserve Tiber final-review enforcement
scenarios.purpose: Verify that the tasks skill refuses prose-only review evidence and describes the durable completion and delivery gate.
scenarios.userInput: Use the local Codex skill "tasks". A project enables Tiber's final-review policy. Two clean reviews preceded a third review that found a bug; the bug is now fixed. Write task-policy.md explaining whether the task may be marked done or closed from a commit trailer, what durable Tiber records are required, what happens after findings or changes to source/scope/verification evidence, and whether a one-run bypass is allowed. Do not mutate a task board or perform Git operations.
successChecklist: The artifact refuses completion and trailer-driven delivery after the finding and fix.
It requires three fresh consecutive clean independent reviews recorded through Tiber's durable review surface.
It explains source, scope, and verification staleness/reset behavior and the auditable configuration-only opt-out.
